goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T001 is sufficiently evidenced to approve a sequential implementation. Keep default-flow docs first; add Custom Flows and Flow Reference after Configuration; extend existing Styling and JavaScript API pages. Use one checked-in versioned manifest rendered by docs/examples and prove it against hashed immutable v1.56.3 declaration snapshots plus vendored-runtime provenance. Embed a curated exact-runtime gallery in the guide/reference rather than adding a builder or separate lab. T003 is the largest safe first slice because every later claim and selector must depend on its reviewed inventory. Dirty homepage files remain untouched; the already-dirty CI workflow is reserved for a cumulative T007 patch.

information_architecture: Preserve Getting Started, Installation, Configuration, and the default feedback flow as the primary path.
Add Custom Flows immediately after Configuration as the task-oriented guide.
Add Flow Reference immediately after Custom Flows as the exhaustive manifest-driven reference.
Extend the existing Styling page with default script styling, Flow appearance/presentation controls, and Shadow DOM boundaries.
Extend the existing JavaScript API page with registerFlow, open context/initialAnswers, result, close, and outcomes.

restricted: Use Classic only where existing historical/version context requires it.
Do not call the default flow legacy or deprecated.
Keep Variant-only capabilities explicitly separate from Flow capabilities.

contents: all Flow field and option discriminators
all screen, condition, presentation, appearance, transition, easing, issue, evidence, lifecycle, and outcome values
numeric bounds, built-in defaults, direction behavior, and reduced-motion behavior
canonical_manifest.proof_inputs: Immutable Flow and Variant public declaration snapshots plus a provenance file containing source URLs, commit, GitHub blob/content hashes, and local SHA-256 hashes.
canonical_manifest.drift_contract: A TypeScript-AST parity helper extracts the released discriminators, literal values, and numeric/runtime constraints from the snapshots and deep-compares them with the manifest; it also checks the manifest commit/version/runtime digest against the vendored runtime provenance. Documentation tables and example selectors import the manifest and may not repeat complete hand-maintained capability arrays.

example_strategy: Embed one curated exact-runtime gallery in Custom Flows, with reference-page deep links rather than a separate public lab.
Cover all six fields and three screens through a small set of coherent example flows, including branching, layout, issue formatting, evidence, and lifecycle.
Provide a motion selector for none, four built-ins, and custom motion, including Back direction, duration/easing, and reduced-motion replacement.
Provide styling presets covering theme, accent, density, modal size, columns, and spans while explaining default-flow script styling and Shadow DOM limits.
Use only the pinned local runtime and local feedback route; record requests and fail if any external domain or real Issue mutation is attempted.
